passages.text: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
passages.sermon:
Israel was also called Jacob.
Israel gathered everything he owned.
Israel began his journey.
He traveled with all his family and possessions.
Israel arrived at Beersheba.
Beersheba was an important place for his family.
Israel offered sacrifices there.
He gave these sacrifices to God.
This God was the God of his father Isaac.
passages.original: וַיִּסַּ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖א בְּאֵ֣רָה שָּׁ֑בַע וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח זְבָחִ֔ים לֵאלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֥יו יִצְחָֽק׃

passages.text: And that night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He said. “Here I am,” replied Jacob.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Israel at night.
God appeared to Israel in a vision.
God called out, “Jacob, Jacob!”
Jacob answered, “Here I am.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּמַרְאֹ֣ת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֣ב׀ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: “I am God,” He said, “the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jacob.
God said, "I am God."
I am the God of your father Isaac.
Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt.
I will make you into a great nation there.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י הָאֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ אַל־ תִּירָא֙ מֵרְדָ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יְמָה כִּֽי־ לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִֽׂימְךָ֥ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back. And Joseph’s own hands will close your eyes.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jacob in a vision at night.
God said, “I will go down to Egypt with you.
I will also bring you back from Egypt.
Joseph will be with you when you die.
Joseph will close your eyes with his own hands.”
passages.original: אָנֹכִ֗י אֵרֵ֤ד עִמְּךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י אַֽעַלְךָ֣ גַם־ עָלֹ֑ה וְיוֹסֵ֕ף יָשִׁ֥ית יָד֖וֹ עַל־ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of the sons of Israel.
Jacob lived in Beersheba.
Jacob got up and left Beersheba.
The sons of Israel were Jacob’s sons.
The sons of Israel took Jacob, their father, with them.
Pharaoh had sent wagons to carry Jacob.
The sons of Israel put Jacob in the wagons.
The sons of Israel also took their children with them.
The sons of Israel also took their wives with them.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥קָם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־ טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־ נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם בָּעֲגָל֕וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח פַּרְעֹ֖ה לָשֵׂ֥את אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of the Israelites.
Jacob and his family lived in the land of Canaan.
Jacob and his family owned livestock in Canaan.
They also owned other possessions in Canaan.
Jacob and all his descendants gathered their livestock and possessions.
Jacob and all his descendants traveled to Egypt.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶת־ מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־ רְכוּשָׁם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽכְשׁוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְכָל־ זַרְע֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Jacob took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons, and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of the Israelites.
Jacob traveled to Egypt.
Jacob brought all his children with him.
Jacob brought his sons.
Jacob brought his grandsons.
Jacob brought his daughters.
Jacob brought his granddaughters.
Jacob brought all his descendants to Egypt.
passages.original: בָּנָ֞יו וּבְנֵ֤י בָנָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ בְּנֹתָ֛יו וּבְנ֥וֹת בָּנָ֖יו וְכָל־ זַרְע֑וֹ הֵבִ֥יא אִתּ֖וֹ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃ס

passages.text: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
passages.sermon:
Jacob is also called Israel.
Jacob had sons.
Jacob and his sons went to Egypt.
Reuben was Jacob’s firstborn son.
These are the names of Jacob’s sons who went to Egypt.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֧וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַבָּאִ֥ים מִצְרַ֖יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֣ב וּבָנָ֑יו בְּכֹ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵֽן׃

passages.text: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
passages.sermon: Reuben was a son of Jacob.\r\nReuben had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י רְאוּבֵ֑ן חֲנ֥וֹךְ וּפַלּ֖וּא וְחֶצְר֥וֹן וְכַרְמִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
passages.sermon:
Simeon was a son of Jacob.
Simeon had sons.
Their names were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, and Zohar.
Simeon also had a son named Shaul.
Shaul’s mother was a Canaanite woman.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֧ל וְיָמִ֛ין וְאֹ֖הַד וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֑חַר וְשָׁא֖וּל בֶּן־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽית׃

passages.text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.sermon: Levi was a son of Jacob.\r\nLevi had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a son of Jacob and Leah.
Judah had five sons.
Their names were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah.
Er died in the land of Canaan.
Onan also died in the land of Canaan.
Perez was one of Judah’s sons.
Perez had two sons.
Their names were Hezron and Hamul.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֧ר וְאוֹנָ֛ן וְשֵׁלָ֖ה וָפֶ֣רֶץ וָזָ֑רַח וַיָּ֨מָת עֵ֤ר וְאוֹנָן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְחָמֽוּל׃

passages.text: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
passages.sermon: Issachar was a son of Jacob.\r\nIssachar had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר תּוֹלָ֥ע וּפֻוָּ֖ה וְי֥וֹב וְשִׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
passages.sermon: Zebulun was a son of Jacob.\r\nZebulun had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י זְבוּלֻ֑ן סֶ֥רֶד וְאֵל֖וֹן וְיַחְלְאֵֽל׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three.
passages.sermon:
Leah was Jacob’s wife.
Leah gave birth to children for Jacob in Paddan-aram.
Leah had sons.
Leah also had a daughter named Dinah.
Jacob’s sons and daughters from Leah were thirty-three in total.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָֽלְדָ֤ה לְיַעֲקֹב֙ בְּפַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֑וֹ כָּל־ נֶ֧פֶשׁ בָּנָ֛יו וּבְנוֹתָ֖יו שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֹֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
passages.sermon: Gad was a son of Jacob.\r\nGad had seven sons.\r\nTheir names were Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד צִפְי֥וֹן וְחַגִּ֖י שׁוּנִ֣י וְאֶצְבֹּ֑ן עֵרִ֥י וַֽאֲרוֹדִ֖י וְאַרְאֵלִֽי׃

passages.text: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
passages.sermon:
Asher was a son of Jacob.
Asher had several children.
Asher’s children were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah.
Asher also had a daughter named Serah.
Beriah was one of Asher’s sons.
Beriah had two sons.
Beriah’s sons were Heber and Malchiel.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֣רַח אֲחֹתָ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵֽל׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Jacob born to Zilpah—whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.
passages.sermon:
Zilpah was a woman.
Laban gave Zilpah to his daughter Leah.
Leah became the owner of Zilpah.
Zilpah gave birth to sons for Jacob.
Jacob was the father of these sons.
Zilpah gave birth to sixteen sons for Jacob in total.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י זִלְפָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְלֵאָ֣ה בִתּ֑וֹ וַתֵּ֤לֶד אֶת־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה נָֽפֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
passages.sermon: Jacob had a wife named Rachel.\r\nRachel gave birth to two sons.\r\nTheir names were Joseph and Benjamin.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֤י רָחֵל֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יוֹסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃

passages.text: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
passages.sermon:
Joseph lived in the land of Egypt.
Asenath was Joseph’s wife.
Asenath was the daughter of Potiphera.
Potiphera was the priest of On.
Asenath gave birth to two sons for Joseph.
Their names were Manasseh and Ephraim.
passages.original: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְיוֹסֵף֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־ לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־ פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֣ן אֹ֑ן אֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
passages.sermon: Benjamin was a son of Jacob and Rachel.\r\nBenjamin had sons.\r\nTheir names were Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֤לַע וָבֶ֙כֶר֙ וְאַשְׁבֵּ֔ל גֵּרָ֥א וְנַעֲמָ֖ן אֵחִ֣י וָרֹ֑אשׁ מֻפִּ֥ים וְחֻפִּ֖ים וָאָֽרְדְּ׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Rachel born to Jacob—fourteen in all.
passages.sermon:
Rachel was the wife of Jacob.
Rachel gave birth to sons for Jacob.
These sons were born to Jacob by Rachel.
The total number of these sons was fourteen.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖ד לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: The son of Dan: Hushim.
passages.sermon: Dan is a son of Jacob.\r\nDan has one son.\r\nHis son is Hushim.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי־ דָ֖ן חֻשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
passages.sermon: Naphtali was a son of Jacob.\r\nNaphtali had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י נַפְתָּלִ֑י יַחְצְאֵ֥ל וְגוּנִ֖י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשִׁלֵּֽם׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Jacob born to Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
passages.sermon:
Jacob had sons by Bilhah.
Laban gave Bilhah to his daughter Rachel.
Bilhah gave birth to these sons for Jacob.
There were seven sons in total.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְרָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֑וֹ וַתֵּ֧לֶד אֶת־ אֵ֛לֶּה לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב כָּל־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ שִׁבְעָֽה׃

passages.text: All those belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt—his direct descendants, besides the wives of Jacob’s sons—numbered sixty-six persons.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of a large family.
His direct descendants traveled with him to Egypt.
These descendants did not include the wives of Jacob’s sons.
The total number of Jacob’s direct descendants who came to Egypt was sixty-six.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַ֠נֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָ֨ה לְיַעֲקֹ֤ב מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י יְרֵכ֔וֹ מִלְּבַ֖ד נְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵי־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָשֵֽׁשׁ׃

passages.text: And with the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy in all.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Jacob.
Joseph lived in Egypt.
Joseph had two sons in Egypt.
Jacob was the father of a large family.
Jacob’s family traveled to Egypt.
The total number of Jacob’s family members who went to Egypt was seventy.
This number includes Joseph’s two sons born in Egypt.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־ יֻלַּד־ ל֥וֹ בְמִצְרַ֖יִם נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׁנָ֑יִם כָּל־ הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ לְבֵֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֛ב הַבָּ֥אָה מִצְרַ֖יְמָה שִׁבְעִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When Jacob’s family arrived in the land of Goshen, Joseph prepared his chariot and went there to meet his father Israel. Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of Judah and Joseph.
Jacob sent Judah ahead of him.
Jacob told Judah to go to Joseph.
Jacob wanted Judah to get directions to Goshen from Joseph.
Jacob’s family traveled to Goshen.
They arrived in the land of Goshen.
Joseph was the son of Jacob.
Joseph prepared his chariot.
Joseph went to meet his father Israel in Goshen.
Joseph saw his father.
Joseph embraced his father.
Joseph wept on his father’s neck for a long time.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ יְהוּדָ֞ה שָׁלַ֤ח לְפָנָיו֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף לְהוֹרֹ֥ת לְפָנָ֖יו גֹּ֑שְׁנָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה גֹּֽשֶׁן׃ וַיֶּאְסֹ֤ר יוֹסֵף֙ מֶרְכַּבְתּ֔וֹ וַיַּ֛עַל לִקְרַֽאת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אָבִ֖יו גֹּ֑שְׁנָה וַיֵּרָ֣א אֵלָ֗יו וַיִּפֹּל֙ עַל־ צַוָּארָ֔יו וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל־ צַוָּארָ֖יו עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”
passages.sermon:
Israel was Joseph’s father.
Israel spoke to Joseph.
Israel said, “I can die now.”
Israel had seen Joseph’s face.
Israel knew Joseph was still alive.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף אָמ֣וּתָה הַפָּ֑עַם אַחֲרֵי֙ רְאוֹתִ֣י אֶת־ פָּנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י עוֹדְךָ֖ חָֽי׃

passages.text: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, “I will go up and inform Pharaoh: ‘My brothers and my father’s household from the land of Canaan have come to me.
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his brothers and to his father’s household.
Joseph said, “I will go to Pharaoh.
I will tell Pharaoh this message.
‘My brothers and my father’s household have come to me.
They came from the land of Canaan.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ וְאֶל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאֹֽמְרָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אַחַ֧י וּבֵית־ אָבִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנַ֖עַן בָּ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: The men are shepherds; they raise livestock, and they have brought their flocks and herds and all that they own.’
passages.sermon:
Joseph’s brothers are shepherds.
They take care of livestock.
They have brought their flocks.
They have brought their herds.
They have brought everything they own.
passages.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ רֹ֣עֵי צֹ֔אן כִּֽי־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הָי֑וּ וְצֹאנָ֧ם וּבְקָרָ֛ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם הֵבִֽיאוּ׃

passages.text: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh will call for you.
Pharaoh will speak to you.
Pharaoh will ask you a question.
Pharaoh will say, “What is your occupation?”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּֽי־ יִקְרָ֥א לָכֶ֖ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְאָמַ֖ר מַה־ מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: you are to say, ‘Your servants have raised livestock ever since our youth—both we and our fathers.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the land of Goshen, since all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.”
passages.sermon:
We are your servants.
We have raised livestock.
We have done this since our youth.
Our fathers also raised livestock.
We ask to live in the land of Goshen.
The Egyptians detest all shepherds.
passages.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִקְנֶ֜ה הָי֤וּ עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִנְּעוּרֵ֣ינוּ וְעַד־ עַ֔תָּה גַּם־ אֲנַ֖חְנוּ גַּם־ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בַּעֲב֗וּר תֵּשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן כִּֽי־ תוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם כָּל־ רֹ֥עֵה צֹֽאן׃
